svg.title: Distinguishing an interruption from a transition
svg.desc: In the emergency: Some journeys and industrial activity temporarily stopped.. When activity resumes: Existing equipment and habits can bring emissions back.. Changed infrastructure: Different homes, transport and energy systems can support lasting cuts.

g.text: Distinguishing an interruption from a transition
Some journeys and industrial activity temporarily stopped.
Existing equipment and habits can bring emissions back.
Different homes, transport and energy systems can support lasting cuts.
